clips.title: The story
paras: The Badlands is an arid, sun-baked expanse of cracked earth, dust storms, and rocky canyons nestled between Loch Modan and Searing Gorge. Despite being deep within dwarven Khaz Modan, it serves as a volatile frontier dominated by Dark Iron dwarves, troggs, Dustbelcher ogres, and nesting black dragonkin. It also houses the titan ruins of Uldaman and the Horde stronghold of Kargath, making it a critical strategic waypoint.

Wedged south of Loch Modan's verdant hills, the Badlands quickly turns into a sweltering basin of barren flats and rugged ravines. Surviving here requires contending with merciless coyotes, cougars, vultures, and fierce sandstorms that obscure the horizon. Scattered across the plateaus are the crude encampments of the Dustbelcher ogres, while the brooding Dark Iron clan fortifies Angor Fortress and clashes with anyone trespassing on their territory.

In the northern bluffs lies Uldaman, an ancient subterranean complex carved out by the titan-forged earthen. Recently uncovered by Ironforge prospectors, the excavation unearthed monumental secrets regarding the ancient ancestry of the dwarven race. However, digging into the subterranean vaults awoke hordes of vicious Stonevault troggs and animated earthen guardians, slaughtering archaeological teams and turning the digsites outside into bloody skirmish grounds.

The Badlands is one of the Horde's most precarious footholds in the southern Eastern Kingdoms. Established in the northwest, the fortress of Kargath gives Warchief Thrall's forces a base of operations to keep watch on the rogue Dark Horde in nearby Blackrock Mountain. Meanwhile, to the far east lies Lethlor Ravine, a treacherous chasm where black whelps and dangerous black dragonkin guard their brooding grounds under the shadow of the mountains.
